title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 4th Proof The Consensus Of The Prophets

questions.question: According to the passage, how does the agreement of all prophets help show the truth of this Messenger?
questions.answer: It shows that many prophets point to the same truth, so their shared witness supports that he is a real Messenger.

questions.question: What two main things does the agreement of the prophets support?
questions.answer: It supports Allah’s oneness and the truthfulness of this Messenger.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the signs of prophethood found in earlier prophets compared with this Messenger?
questions.answer: It says those signs were found in him fully.

questions.question: In which earlier revealed books did prophets give good news about his coming?
questions.answer: In the Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: Besides spoken predictions, what else from the prophets is described as supporting his mission?
questions.answer: Their actions and miracles also support his mission.

questions.question: What picture does the passage use to show how the prophets confirmed his mission?
questions.answer: It says they were like people placing their signatures on it.

questions.question: Why is his mission described as the highest and most complete among prophetic missions?
questions.answer: Because he is presented as the foremost and most complete in the duties of prophethood.

questions.question: Who else gives united witness after the prophets?
questions.answer: The saints who followed his teaching do.

questions.question: What did those saints gain by following his instruction?
questions.answer: They reached truth, deeper reality, excellence, amazing gifts, spiritual unveiling, and witnessing.

questions.question: What do the saints testify to besides Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: They also testify that this Messenger is truthful and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: How do the saints come to know some of the unseen truths he taught?
questions.answer: They know them through the light of sainthood.

questions.question: What does the passage say their witness shows about him very clearly?
questions.answer: It shows very clearly that he is completely truthful and upright.

questions.question: Why does agreement matter in the passage?
questions.answer: Because when many true people say the same thing, their shared testimony becomes stronger.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities in prophets point to true prophethood?
questions.answer: Their holy qualities, miracles, and duties point to it.

questions.question: How were those qualities related to this Messenger?
questions.answer: The passage says they were present in him in a complete way.

questions.question: How did earlier prophets tell people about him before he came?
questions.answer: They spoke of his coming and gave glad news about him in earlier scriptures.

questions.question: What does it mean that prophets also confirmed him through their deeds?
questions.answer: Their lives and miracles matched and supported the truth of his mission.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the prophets’ words and their deeds?
questions.answer: Their words show Allah’s oneness, and their deeds also witness that this Messenger is true.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the part called “The Fifth”?
questions.answer: The saints also give united witness to Allah’s oneness and to the truth of this Messenger.

questions.question: How are the saints described in this passage?
questions.answer: They are described as many people who reached truth, excellence, and spiritual witnessing by following him.

questions.question: What do the saints see that strengthens their belief in his message?
questions.answer: They see some of the unseen truths he taught.

questions.question: What different levels of certainty are mentioned for the saints’ belief?
questions.answer: Certainty through knowledge, certainty through direct seeing, and full certainty.

questions.question: Who is meant by “this being” in the target passage?
questions.answer: It means the Messenger being discussed in the passage.

questions.question: What kind of proof is the agreement of the prophets called?
questions.answer: It is called a strong and firm proof.

questions.question: What does that proof say about the Messenger?
questions.answer: It says he is truthful and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: What source is named for knowing that earlier prophets gave news of his coming?
questions.answer: Earlier revealed scriptures are named as the source.

questions.question: Name two of those scriptures.
questions.answer: The Torah and the Psalms.

questions.question: What does the passage say history shows about him and the earlier prophets?
questions.answer: History shows that the marks of true prophethood were fully present in him.

questions.question: What kind of people are mentioned in “The Fifth”?
questions.answer: Saints who followed his teaching are mentioned.

questions.question: How did these saints reach high spiritual states?
questions.answer: They reached them by learning from him and following him.

questions.question: What do the saints witness about Allah?
questions.answer: They witness Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What do they witness about the Messenger?
questions.answer: They witness that he is truthful and truly a Messenger.

questions.question: Why is their witness described as being like the sun?
questions.answer: Because it is presented as very bright, clear, and hard to deny.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the prophets’ shared testimony important?
questions.answer: Because all of them together support the same message about Allah and this Messenger.

questions.question: What three things in prophets are said to show true prophethood?
questions.answer: Their noble qualities, their miracles, and their prophetic duties.

questions.question: How fully were these things found in this Messenger?
questions.answer: They were found in him completely.

questions.question: What did earlier prophets do in their scriptures concerning him?
questions.answer: They announced his coming and gave people good news about him.

questions.question: What does the image of “signing” his mission help the reader understand?
questions.answer: It helps the reader understand that the prophets strongly approved and confirmed his mission.

questions.question: What can we learn from the line about the prophets’ deeds being in agreement?
questions.answer: We learn that their actions, not just their words, support his truthfulness.

questions.question: Who are the next group of witnesses after the prophets?
questions.answer: The saints are the next group.

questions.question: What happened to these saints through following him?
questions.answer: They reached spiritual truth, maturity, and special awareness.

questions.question: What part of his teachings did they especially witness for themselves?
questions.answer: They witnessed some truths about the unseen world.

questions.question: Did the saints accept only some of his teachings or all of them?
questions.answer: They affirmed all of them.

questions.question: What helped them affirm all of his teachings?
questions.answer: The light of faith helped them affirm them.

questions.question: What final conclusion about the Messenger is supported by the saints’ witness?
questions.answer: That he is completely truthful and straight in character.

questions.question: What two groups give testimony in this target passage?
questions.answer: The prophets and the saints give testimony.

questions.question: What do both groups agree about first of all?
questions.answer: They agree about Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What do both groups also agree about concerning the Messenger?
questions.answer: They agree that he is truthful and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: How is the witness of the prophets different from the witness of the saints in this passage?
questions.answer: The prophets foretold him and confirmed him, while the saints reached spiritual certainty by following him.

questions.question: What evidence from the prophets comes through speech?
questions.answer: Their giving glad news and telling about his coming in revealed books.

questions.question: What evidence from the prophets comes through action?
questions.answer: Their miracles and prophetic works support his mission.

questions.question: What does the phrase about “light of sainthood” suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that saints were given spiritual insight.

questions.question: What does the phrase about “light of belief” suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that faith gave them confidence and certainty in what he taught.

questions.question: What is one reason the saints are strong witnesses?
questions.answer: They personally experienced truths by following his path.

questions.question: What kinds of certainty are listed in the passage?
questions.answer: Certainty from knowledge, certainty from seeing, and complete certainty.

questions.question: If someone asks why the saints’ testimony matters, what is a good short answer from the passage?
questions.answer: Because they learned from him, saw truths confirmed, and then agreed that he is true.

questions.question: What overall lesson would a student take from both sections together?
questions.answer: That many truthful people across time confirmed the Messenger from both revelation and spiritual experience.

questions.question: In “The Fourth,” what is used as a proof along with the prophets’ agreement about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: Their agreement is also used as proof of the Messenger’s truthfulness and mission.

questions.question: What does the passage say existed in this Messenger just as in the other prophets?
questions.answer: The signs, miracles, qualities, and duties connected to true prophethood.

questions.question: Where did the prophets give people advance news about him?
questions.answer: In earlier holy books and revealed pages.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both spoken witness and practical witness from the prophets?
questions.answer: To show they supported him in more than one way.

questions.question: Which kind of witness from the prophets points especially to his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Their united deeds and miracles point especially to his truthfulness.

questions.question: In “The Fifth,” how many saints are said to give witness?
questions.answer: Thousands of saints are said to give witness.

questions.question: What made those saints able to reach high spiritual levels?
questions.answer: They reached them through his teaching and by following him.

questions.question: What truths taught by the Messenger are especially mentioned here?
questions.answer: Truths about the unseen world are especially mentioned.

questions.question: How strongly do the saints believe the truths he taught?
questions.answer: They believe them with strong levels of certainty.

questions.question: Why is their witness important for understanding his character?
questions.answer: Because it shows that people who knew spiritual truth found him completely honest and upright.

questions.question: What did the traveller realize from the witness of the saints?
questions.answer: He realized that their testimony clearly proves the Messenger’s truthfulness.

questions.question: Give one short summary sentence for the whole target passage.
questions.answer: The passage teaches that both the prophets before him and the saints after him clearly confirm that he is Allah’s true Messenger.
